jobs.prompt: Refine this exact BrineSpace L-counter. Darken and desaturate the golden wood to muted medium walnut brown, matching the accepted reference bookcase's wood, retaining broad readable grain. Preserve books, mug, box and towels. Essential: preserve exact square-room outer footprint, straight horizontal top wall-contact back and straight vertical outer return back. Preserve facing and full arm lengths. Improve construction depth: show a narrow dark inner vertical cabinet side along the long return, with visible top lip and grounded base, so it reads substantial raised counter not a flat floor strip. Keep the added inner side INSIDE original overall bounds, not jutting into the doorway. Maintain overhead/cutaway camera, cabinet working-height proportions and accessory scale. Restrained hand-painted industrial finish matching accepted art, no dense microtexture, glossy reflections, white piping or extra clutter. Genuine transparent background/inner corner, no wall, floor, exterior shadow, people or text. Full silhouette and margins.
